title: Dispatch: olc5.14 horn-type variants + engine-rolled grant count bound to the use; vessels count 1 (attempt 1, Sonnet)
description:
Implements eshyra-olc5.14. Read `bd show eshyra-olc5.14` first: its description, acceptance criteria and the 2026-10-18 USER DECISION note are the spec. Also read docs/rules-pack-compiler.md and docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. The importer protocol is MANDATORY because the generated pack changes. Locate code by symbol name. Base: origin/main dbbede8d (PR #673 merged).

GOAL
Enforce source-backed creature multiplicity at the use_item -> start_effect grant-binding boundary for two cases:
- Horn of Valhalla: a count rolled per use from the instance's horn type.
- The four elemental vessels: a fixed count of 1.
Do nothing else.

CODE SURVEY (verified by the captain)
- validateItemGrantBinding (state/activeEffects.ts, ~L3954) enforces only `typeof grant.count === 'number' && actors.length !== grant.count`.
- creatureGrantLifecycleOwned (scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemGrantOwnership.ts) requires `typeof grant.count === 'number'`, so the Horn and vessel m4 entityGrant clauses stay engine-pending.
- Curated grant specs live in magicItemEntityGrants.ts:
  - The `elementalVessel(...)` helper omits count.
  - The 'Horn of Valhalla' spec has tableRefs [table:horn-of-valhalla] and no count.
- Horn record (pack): no `variants`. Its rarity is "rare (silver or brass), very rare (bronze), or legendary (iron)".
- table:horn-of-valhalla, columns [d100, Horn Type, Berserkers Summoned, Requirement]:
  - 01–40 Silver, 2d4 + 2, None
  - 41–75 Brass, 3d4 + 3, Proficiency with all simple weapons
  - 76–90 Bronze, 4d4 + 4, Proficiency with all medium armor
  - 91–00 Iron, 5d4 + 5, Proficiency with all martial weapons
- Existing variant machinery:
  - Record `data.variants` [{id, name, rarity, text, mechanics?}], built by the reviewed variant specs in parseMagicItems.ts (INLINE_VARIANT_SPECS, extractFigurineVariants).
  - grant.variants restricts a grant to variants. magicItemMechanics.ts says it is required on every grant of an item that declares variants (S1).
  - The instance stores variant_id. give_item/adopt_item take variantId (resolveMagicItemVariant).
  - Bind credits carry variantId (itemGrantBinding.ts ItemGrantBindCredit).
  - The Figurine of Wondrous Power is the precedent: one variant-restricted creature grant per variant.
- Spend -> bind boundary: use_item issues bind credits (issueBindCredits in itemState.ts; issueItemGrantBindCredit / oldestOpenItemGrantBindCredit / redeemItemGrantBindCredit in itemGrantBinding.ts) or anchored spends. start_effect redeems them.
- The Horn's economy is an elapsed-time 'cooldown' (7 days). Its c1-cooldown clause is already green.

DECISIONS (made; do not relitigate)
1. HORN TYPE = magic-item VARIANT (user decision, option (a)).
   - Add four source-backed variants (silver, brass, bronze, iron) to Horn of Valhalla through a reviewed variant spec.
   - Name each from the table row's Horn Type, and take each rarity from the printed rarity line (Silver/Brass rare, Bronze very rare, Iron legendary).
   - Each variant's text must carry its row's count dice and requirement verbatim, so the DM still sees the requirement.
   - The type is fixed on the instance (variant_id) when it enters play. DM choice uses the existing give_item/adopt_item variantId.
   - Random determination: the DM rolls the table's d100 column with the existing engine roll tool and supplies the matching variantId. Do NOT build a new random-variant-selection API. If give_item's tool description needs one sentence saying this for the Horn, add it.
   - The type is NEVER reselected per activation.
   - If the variant machinery cannot faithfully represent the four types, STOP and record the specific limitation (leave this bead open). Do not add another storage mechanism.
2. HORN COUNT = an ENGINE ROLL bound to the use.
   - Give each variant-restricted Horn grant a typed rolled count, e.g. a new optional grant field `countRoll: '2d4+2'`, mutually exclusive with `count`. Validate it in magicItemMechanics.ts with the existing dice-notation helpers.
   - When use_item spends the Horn's cooldown and issues the bind credit, the engine rolls that variant's countRoll in the same transaction. It persists the roll (notation, dice, total) on that credit (or the anchored-spend record), with provenance, and returns the total in the hint so the DM can see it.
   - start_effect refuses the bind when actors.length !== the stored total, and when no engine roll is recorded for the credit being redeemed. Never accept a caller-supplied count or roll.
   - Do a schema migration only if one is needed (a nullable column on item_grant_bind_credit is fine). Follow the existing migration pattern.
   - Replay/reload must reproduce the same stored roll; nothing re-rolls.
3. VESSELS: count 1 in the elementalVessel helper. The binder already enforces fixed counts.
4. OWNERSHIP: extend creatureGrantLifecycleOwned so that a grant is admitted when it has a number `count`, OR a `countRoll` (now enforced by the binding). Everything else in the rule is unchanged.
   - Expected result: Horn of Valhalla and the four vessels become owned.
   - Newly owned grants need their F2 control split exactly as c58j.1 did for the others: a hook-free adjudicated m4-control- clause with the verbatim control sentence, via CONTROL_SPANS in magicItemEntityGrants.ts, integrity-checked. Check whether spans for these items already exist from c58j.1.
   - EXPECTED READINESS DELTA: Horn blow-horn becomes READY. The vessel operations stay NOT ready, because c1-uses 'F5 per-period usage reset' (owned by eshyra-7gkh) still blocks them. Do not touch that hook.
5. RETAINED BY THE DM, with no code: requirement/proficiency checking, hostility vs friendliness, control, placement, combat decisions.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE (minimum; no fixture matrices)
- Real unmodified pack, no readiness waiver, in test/itemGrantRealPackReadiness.test.ts (BIND table) or a sibling file:
  - Horn (one variant is enough): use_item -> the engine-rolled total appears in the hint and is persisted.
  - A bind with exactly that many actors succeeds.
  - A bind with a mismatched count is refused.
  - A bind against a credit with no recorded roll, or an attempt to supply a different roll, is refused.
  - A second bind is refused.
- Real pack: one vessel bind with 1 actor accepted and 2 refused, at the binder level. The vessel operation is not ready, so do not waive readiness; if the binder cannot be reached without a waiver, test validateItemGrantBinding's count rule through the same real-pack record.
- magicItemGrantOwnership.test.ts: update the whole-pack re-derivation, the owned set now including the Horn and vessels, and a synthetic counterfactual (countRoll present vs absent).
- Variant-spec integrity: the four variants trace to the table rows and rarity line. A test fails if the table text changes.
- Update the generated-pack baselines (srdGeneratedPack counts, the hooked-clause invariant, the magicItemOperationSourceAgreement READY list +blow-horn, the semi-structured inventory) WITHOUT weakening them, and add the thaw note the protocol requires.

RECORD in notes: before/after hook and clause counts, the readiness delta, the migration (if any), and every place an existing Horn instance without a variant is now handled. A held Horn with no variant must be refused fail-closed until its type is established. If there is no path to establish the type on an already-held instance, record that as a finding; do not build one.

VERIFY: run the focused suites, `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`, and `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing.

STOP and record (leave the bead open) if: variants cannot faithfully represent the horn types; binding the roll to the use needs more than a credit/spend-row field; or a decided point conflicts with code or source.

DESIGN: Horn record gains variants Silver/Brass/Bronze/Iron (rarity Rare/Rare/Very Rare/Legendary from printed line; text 'Berserkers Summoned: <dice>. Requirement: <req>.' verbatim from table rows); pinned in parseMagicItems.ts HORN_OF_VALHALLA_TYPES with throw on rarity-line/description drift, and assertHornOfValhallaTypesMatchTable called from emit aborts if table rows drift. Four grants silver-berserkers.. each variants:[id] + countRoll (new optional grant field, mutually exclusive with count, creature grants only, validated via dice() in magicItemMechanics; kept by triage GRANT_KEEP). use_item rolls countRoll with input.rng in the issueBindCredits transaction (fails closed with no rng), persists on credit, returns hint.bindCredits[].rolledCounts. validateItemGrantBinding: countRoll grant needs a bind credit (refuses anchored/receipt paths), credit must hold a roll for that grant with matching notation, actors.length must equal total. No caller field exists (start_effect schema refuses extra count/rolledCount). creatureGrantLifecycleOwned: numeric count OR string countRoll. Vessels: count:1 in elementalVessel + source phrase 'summon a/an <x> elemental' checked. Tool descriptions updated (give_item Horn variantId/random d100 via roll tool; use_item; start_effect). HORN WITHOUT VARIANT: give_item/use_item without variantId refused ('requires variantId; expected one of silver, brass, bronze, iron'); an already-held Horn row (pack_ref=horn, variant_id NULL, from before this change) is refused by use_item (same message) and by start_effect (variant-bearing item, instance names no variant) = fail-closed. FINDING: there is NO path to establish the type on an already-held horn row: adopt_item only adopts pack_ref IS NULL rows and give_item cannot change variant of an existing packRef row; no code built, per instruction. Pre-existing credits (before migration 0050) carry NULL roll and are refused for Horn binds (Horn was never bindable-owned before, so harmless). TESTS: new test/itemGrantRolledCount.test.ts (real unmodified pack, no waiver: Horn silver/iron use->roll shown+persisted, exact count binds, +/-1 refused, other-variant grant refused, caller-supplied count/rolledCount refused, null/other-grant/other-notation roll refused, second bind refused, seeded determinism, no-variant fail-closed; 4 vessels: 1 actor binds, 2 refused via directly issued credit since ops not ready); test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/hornOfValhallaVariants.test.ts (variants/rarity/countRoll trace to table rows; drift throws); magicItemGrantOwnership.test.ts updated (owned set incl. Horn+vessels, countRoll present/absent counterfactual); source-agreement READY +4; itemGrantRealPackReadiness CONFORMANCE_BACKED +blow-horn; srdGeneratedPack baselines (clause total/counts, variants missingCount 236->235); migration tests; itemGrantBindCredit generic loop skips rolled-count carriers (covered by new file); semi-structured inventory regenerated (1859->1860 rows); thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-10-18-eshyra-olc5-14-1-grant-creature-count.md. DEVIATIONS: (1) numeric-conservation gate: variant text dice (variant scope) vs grant countRoll (parent scope) required 8 keyed exceptions with rationale in srdGeneratedPack.test.ts (Figurine 3d10+3 precedent) rather than moving grants into variant mechanics, which would need a new variant projector and variant-scoped readiness; expectation not weakened, exceptions must all be used. (2) Rolled count lives in a JSON array column (not a single total) so a credit listing several rolled grants stays well-formed; only one per credit in practice. (3) countRoll hint also carries rolls/modifier for DM visibility. No STOP conditions hit.
